beefs.title: Kesava Pillai of Kandamath
beefs.about: Nominated for deletion; see :Wikipedia:Articles for deletion/Kesava Pillai of Kandamath (2nd nomination).
quotes: Nominated for deletion; see :Wikipedia:Articles for deletion/Kesava Pillai of Kandamath (2nd nomination).

User:OutroCanary you have now been told multiple times to list the article at WP:AFD for deletion. I have recently needed to reallocate my volunteer time for this coming week, so if you are still confused I suggest you seek additional assistance at the WP:Helpdesk.

"Madom Thampuran Vaka" is standard tax and property terminology denoting land assigned to a family shrine or guardian spirit. Modern family chroniclers or casual internet editors took that exact property phrase from old deeds, misread the word "Thampuran" as a literal royal king, upgraded the family's ancestral Madom (homestead) into a "medieval palace," and pasted it onto Wikipedia. Over time, lazy internet copy-pasting turned a private family claim into a pseudo-historical "fact."
